titles.en: Stele of Cao Quan, original stone

productionDate.note: The current Beilin entry and Palace Museum agree on 185. An alternate Beilin entry gives 186.

dimensions.note: The alternate Beilin entry gives a width of 95 cm; the Palace Museum entry gives 123 cm. The width remains unresolved.

currentCollection.note: Xi’an Beilin lists the original stone and records its transfer in 1956. The Palace Museum catalogues a distinct early Ming rubbing and names Beilin as the stone’s holding institution.
currentCollection.noteZh: 西安碑林著录原石，并记载于 1956 年移存。故宫另有明初拓本，目录同时指出原石藏于西安碑林。

review.note: Draft object record. The collection assertion comes from the cited page but has not been reviewed against the object itself.
review.noteZh: 草稿记录。现藏依据来自所引页面，但尚未与实物核对，也未经独立审核。

notes: The current Beilin entry and the Palace Museum give 185; a second Beilin entry gives 186.
The two width readings are 95 cm and 123 cm. The structured dimension states only the common height.
No coordinate is recorded: the source names an institution, not a surveyed point.
The stele does not name a scribe, so no attribution is asserted.
The Beilin entry records discovery in the Wanli era and transfer in 1956. The current display spot is unverified.
notesZh: 西安碑林现行中文目录和故宫条目均作 185 年；西安碑林另一条目作 186 年。
两处著录的碑宽分别是 95 和 123 厘米，尺寸字段仅记一致的碑高。
未记录坐标：来源给出的是机构名称，不是实测点位。
碑上未署书者姓名，因此不主张书写者。
碑林条目记载万历年间出土、1956 年移存；未核实当前的展出位置。
